description: Whether a loaded page has PAINTED: the probe a client runs in its web view after a load finishes, and how long a cover is held for a page that never reports a paint. The ONE owner of both. core/render-ready.js exports them for the desktop, and the iOS client bundles this file and evaluates the same probe with callAsyncJavaScript.
why: A load that finished is not a page on screen: the Control UI builds itself after its load event, so a cover taken down on the load showed an empty window between Try again and the page (2026-09-24). A second copy of the probe in Swift would be a second answer to that question.
